what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in Serbia and Kosovo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 57 Russian refugees in Serbia and Kosovo, 0.1% of all refugees from Russia.
France hosts the most Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Russia in 1966, the main year of displacement in the data.
UCDP's later conflicts in Russia include Chechnya from 1994 to 2007 and an interstate armed conflict with Ukraine from 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1966 at its highest figure, 17970 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Serbia and Kosovo.
These are year-end totals for Serbia and Kosovo only, reported to UNHCR.
